behavior.unbound: render bundled public landmark names transcribed from the supplied reference map
behavior.boundEmpty: render the configured empty state without restoring bundled rows
behavior.invalidRows: skip rows whose id or name is missing
behavior.ordering: sort by category and destination name while preserving the id used to match reviewed SVG geometry
behavior.mapPresence: derive map presence from matching reviewed SVG geometry; datasource rows cannot create map anchors
behavior.accessibility: missing accessible values remain visibly unverified and are never inferred
